content.value: . What are the equations used when a gas is modeled as an ideal gas? One kilogram of air in a piston-cylinder assembly undergoes a thermodynamic cycle consisting of three processes. Process 1 - 2: constant specific volume, Process ${ 2 \to 3 } ;$ constant temperature expansion, Process 3 – 1: constant pressure compression. At state 1, the temperature is 300 K, and ther pressure is 1.012 bar. At state 2, the temperature is 2.0 bar . Using ideal gas equation of state –
(i) Sketch the cycle on p - v coordinate.
(iii) Determine the specific-volume at state 3 (molecular weight of air is 29 g/mol).
